messages:
Ava (PM, DevEx): Heads-up — Q4 roadmap planning doc calls out a "multi-model sample app" ask from two enterprise trials. Need to decide minimal scope to ship a reference that demos SDK routing + fallbacks.
Sam (SDK Eng): Can we clarify customer ask? is it model selection on latency/cost, or preferring private models when available?
Jon (Solutions Eng): From customer A: wants runtime routing by 'cost tier' + automatic fallback to hosted smaller model when dedicated pool saturated. Also wants example of embedding + rerank pipeline.
Priya (DX Engineer): Quick thought — we could split into two deliverables: 1) sample app showing SDK routing + policy config, and 2) an eval harness that shows latency/cost tradeoffs. Ship 1 first.
Ava (PM, DevEx): Agree. Proposed MVP scope: - SDK example with policy config (latency/cost/region) - simple web UI + server code using SDK - documented rollout/fallback behavior - test prompts & small dataset for eval. No heavy infra or dedicated deployment.
Luca (Product): Must map to OKRs: "Reduce time-to-first-success for enterprise trials" and "Improve docs-to-ship metric". MVP should be <=3 sprints.
Sam (SDK Eng): Tech notes: routing policy will reuse existing route table code, but need sample config schema. I can prototype API surface in 1 sprint if we accept a single policy type to start.
Priya (DX Engineer): Draft launch criteria: - README with quickstart <10 min - 2 sample prompts (chat, embedding+rerank) - CI test that runs a smoke request against hosted model - API surface doc + code comments.
Jon (Solutions Eng): Risks: customer requests private deployment example (VPC) — that's higher effort. We should offer a "handbook" note explaining how to adapt for Private, but not implement in MVP.
Ava (PM, DevEx): Decision drift check: MVP excludes Private deployment, excludes Dedicated autoscale examples. Include a short "Next steps / v2" section listing those.
Sam (SDK Eng): Will need a tiny infra checklist for reviewers: env var names, token handling, and example policy JSON. Example snippet to include in sample app:
```json
{"routing_policy": {"priority": ["hosted-lowcost", "dedicated-preferred"], "fallback": "hosted-small"}}
```
Priya (DX Engineer): I'll own docs + quickstart flow. Sam owns SDK code + sample server. Jon will own customer review. Ava will coordinate timeline.
Ava (PM, DevEx): Timeline proposal: Sprint 1 (spec + proto) -> Sprint 2 (build + docs) -> Sprint 3 (QA + customer review + launch). Target: end of sprint 3 for internal release.
deploy-bot: Ticket created: DEVEX-4123 "multi-model-sample-app: MVP" assigned to Sam, Priya.
Luca (Product): +1 on timeline. Also request we capture telemetry knobs to be exposed in console (route metrics). Add to v2 backlog.
Sam (SDK Eng): Quick ask — can eng time be reprioritized? I estimate ~2.5 dev-weeks.
Ava (PM, DevEx): I'll take to eng leads. For now, owners, send an initial spec doc by EOD Fri. Priya, please draft minimal quickstart steps by Tue.
Priya (DX Engineer): On it. I'll post a short spec link when ready.
Jon (Solutions Eng): I'll flag customer A that we'll deliver MVP first and follow up on Private example separately.
Ava (PM, DevEx): Cool. Closing this thread — action items: Sam prototype API, Priya quickstart draft, Ava coordinate prioritization, Jon customer comms.
